Container.Name: Defibrillarr
Container.Overview: Defibrillarr is a lightweight companion service for Unraid that automatically revives stalled downloads in qBittorrent by injecting verified live public trackers. If a torrent remains dead after a grace period, Defibrillarr coordinates with Sonarr, Radarr, and Lidarr to delete the stuck torrent, blocklist the bad release, and trigger an immediate search for a healthy replacement.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web UI port for Defibrillarr dashboard

Config.Name: qBittorrent URL
Config.Description: URL of your qBittorrent Web UI

Config.Name: Sonarr URL

Config.Description: Sonarr API Key (Settings -> General -> API Key)

Config.Name: Radarr URL

Config.Name: Radarr API Key
Config.Description: Radarr API Key (Settings -> General -> API Key)

Config.Name: Lidarr URL
Config.Description: URL of your Lidarr instance (leave blank if not using)

Config.Name: Lidarr API Key
Config.Description: Lidarr API Key (Settings -> General -> API Key)

Config.Name: Stall Threshold (Minutes)
Config.Description: Minutes with 0 seeds / below min speed before Stage 1 tracker injection

Config.Name: Rescue Grace Period (Minutes)
Config.Description: Minutes to wait in boosting mode before Stage 2 failover

Config.Name: Minimum Speed (KB/s)
Config.Description: Downloads under this speed are classified as stalled

Config.Description: Log actions without modifying qBittorrent or Servarr
